model.name: qwen3.6-35b-a3b (agent)
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3.6, mixture of experts (35B, about 3B active), FP8 as published by Qwen. Apache-2.0. Fits an A100 (about 44 GB of 80; FP8 through vLLM's fallback path there). Tests speed against the 27B dense Qwen: far fewer active parameters per token. Thinking off, as for the other Qwen profiles.

SELECT
  c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
  COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND IS_ACTV = true

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON f.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND j.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC

SELECT
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND br.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.IS_MTH_END = true
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = true
;

SELECT
    ctg.dsplay_nm AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.dsplay_nm
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS num_clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.MTH_NM = 'August'
  AND d.IS_MTH_END = true
  AND f.DFLT_FLG = true;

SELECT
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  f.CCY_CD1,
  AVG(f.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, f.CCY_CD1

SELECT
  m.DSPLY_NM AS market_name,
  d.CAL_YR_NBR AS calendar_year,
  d.MTH_NM AS month_name,
  SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_MKT m ON f.MKT_K = m.MKT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY
  m.DSPLY_NM,
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NM
ORDER BY
  d.CAL_YR_NBR,
  d.MTH_NBR,
  m.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT ACCT_TYP_CD1, COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE IS_CURR = true
  AND OPND_DT >= '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1

SELECT b.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR b ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND b.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY b.CTY_NM
ORDER BY b.CTY_NM

SELECT
  AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR,
  COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1

WITH cust_with_txn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.BUS_ID
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND c.IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_account_transaction_in_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  AND c.BUS_ID NOT IN (SELECT BUS_ID FROM cust_with_txn);

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fa.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    cat.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaints
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY escalated_complaints DESC

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    SUM(f.FEE_AMT) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_fees DESC

SELECT SUM(fd.txn_amt) AS total_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT fd
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fd.bus_dt_k = dt.dt_k
WHERE dt.cal_yr_nbr = 2025
  AND fd.dspt_rsn_cd1 = 'FRAUD';

WITH high_alerts AS (
    SELECT
        fa.JUR_K,
        fa.AMNT_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT fa
    WHERE fa.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fa.BUS_DT_K) = 2025
)
SELECT
    dj.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM high_alerts ha
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR dj
    ON ha.JUR_K = dj.JUR_K
    AND dj.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY dj.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_more_than_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250831
  AND DYS_PST_DUE > 90

SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) AS cal_year,
  COUNT(*) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT)
ORDER BY cal_year;

SELECT 
    lp.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(fb.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_BAL_D fb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD lp
    ON fb.LN_PRD_K = lp.LN_PRD_K
WHERE fb.BUS_DT_K = 20251231
GROUP BY lp.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY total_outstanding_principal DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS distinct_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON w.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
WHERE w.IS_CRSS_BRDR = true
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND c.IS_CURR = true
;

WITH branch_txn AS (
    SELECT br.RGN_CD1,
           br.DSPLY_NM,
           br.BUS_ID,
           COUNT(*) as txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f.BR_K = br.BR_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND br.IS_CURR = true
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM, br.BUS_ID
)
SELECT RGN_CD1,
       DSPLY_NM,
       BUS_ID,
       txn_count
FROM (
    SELECT RGN_CD1,
           DSPLY_NM,
           BUS_ID,
           txn_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RGN_CD1 ORDER BY txn_count DESC) as rn
    FROM branch_txn
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY RGN_CD1

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        fa.MRCH_K,
        fa.AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
    WHERE dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
merchant_cat AS (
    SELECT
        dm.MRCH_K,
        dm.MRCH_CLSSF_CD1 AS merchant_category_code
    FROM bank_dwh.D_MRCH dm
    WHERE dm.IS_CURR = TRUE
)
SELECT
    mc.merchant_category_code,
    SUM(a.AMT::NUMERIC) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM auth_2025 a
JOIN merchant_cat mc ON a.MRCH_K = mc.MRCH_K
GROUP BY mc.merchant_category_code
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.BUS_ID, SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d ON f.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.IS_CURR = true
GROUP BY d.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
  wt.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(CAST(wt.AMT AS NUMERIC)) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON wt.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY wt.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY wt.CCY_CD1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_both_wire_and_atm
FROM (
  SELECT w.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
  INTERSECT
  SELECT a.CUST_K
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND a.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
) sub

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT d.IS_WKND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab_jun.ACCT_K) AS accounts_with_10pct_drop
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D ab_jun
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D ab_dec
    ON ab_jun.ACCT_K = ab_dec.ACCT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_jun
    ON ab_jun.BUS_DT_K = dt_jun.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt_dec
    ON ab_dec.BUS_DT_K = dt_dec.DT_K
WHERE dt_jun.CAL_DT = '2025-06-30'
  AND dt_dec.CAL_DT = '2025-12-31'
  AND ab_jun.CLSNG_BAL_AMT > 0
  AND ab_dec.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < ab_jun.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.9
  AND ab_dec.CLSNG_BAL_AMT IS NOT NULL
  AND ab_jun.CLSNG_BAL_AMT IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  cat.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.RSLTN_AT - f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)), 2) AS avg_days_to_resolution
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cat ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = cat.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.IS_RSLVD = true
  AND f.RSLTN_AT IS NOT NULL
  AND f.CNTCT_STRTD_AT IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cat.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY cat.DSPLY_NM;

WITH current_cust AS (
  SELECT BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  WHERE IS_CURR = true
),
first_version AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (BUS_ID) BUS_ID, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  ORDER BY BUS_ID, VRSN_NBR ASC
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM current_cust c
JOIN first_version f ON c.BUS_ID = f.BUS_ID
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 != f.CUST_SGMNT_CD1

WITH cust_quarters AS (
  SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    d.QTR_NBR
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY c.BUS_ID, d.QTR_NBR
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS customers_with_txns_in_all_4_quarters_2025
FROM (
  SELECT BUS_ID
  FROM cust_quarters
  GROUP BY BUS_ID
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4
) sub

WITH dispute_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND d.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND w.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_with_dispute_no_wire
FROM dispute_customers dc
WHERE dc.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM wire_customers);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT a.LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D a
  JOIN bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D b ON a.LN_ID = b.LN_ID
  WHERE a.BUS_DT_K = 20240630
    AND a.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
    AND b.BUS_DT_K = 20250630
    AND b.DYS_PST_DUE > 30
) sub

WITH wire_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        fw.CCY_CD1,
        fw.AMT::NUMERIC AS amt_num
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fw
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fw.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND fw.AMT IS NOT NULL
      AND fw.AMT != ''
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CCY_CD1,
        amt_num,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY amt_num) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1) AS cnt
    FROM wire_2025
)
SELECT
    CCY_CD1,
    CASE
        WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
            (SELECT amt_num FROM ranked r2 WHERE r2.CCY_CD1 = ranked.CCY_CD1 AND r2.rn = (cnt + 1) / 2)
        ELSE
            (SELECT AVG(amt_num) FROM ranked r2 WHERE r2.CCY_CD1 = ranked.CCY_CD1 AND r2.rn IN (cnt / 2, cnt / 2 + 1))
    END AS median_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN (
    CASE WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN (cnt + 1) / 2 ELSE cnt / 2 END,
    CASE WHEN cnt % 2 = 0 THEN cnt / 2 + 1 ELSE NULL END
)
GROUP BY CCY_CD1, cnt
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH mobile_txn AS (
  SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c ON f.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE c.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
    AND d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 THEN txn_count END) AS txn_2025,
  MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count END) AS txn_2024,
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 THEN txn_count END) - MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count END))::NUMERIC
    / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count END), 0)
    * 100, 1
  ) AS pct_growth
FROM mobile_txn;

WITH month_end_snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR,
    d.MTH_NBR,
    d.CAL_DT,
    SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND d.IS_MTH_END = true
  GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR, d.MTH_NBR, d.CAL_DT
)
SELECT
  MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  total_closing_balance
FROM month_end_snapshots
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.BUS_ID) AS customers_with_txn
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_txn
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d_txn.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_cust
  ON c.CUST_SNC_DT = d_cust.CAL_DT
WHERE c.IS_CURR = true
  AND d_cust.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d_txn.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT > '2023-06-30' OR EFF_TO_DT IS NULL)
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
    c.BUS_ID,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND c.IS_CURR = true
    AND f.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1, c.BUS_ID
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    segment_code,
    BUS_ID,
    total_wire_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment_code ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC) AS rn
  FROM customer_totals
)
SELECT
  segment_code,
  BUS_ID,
  total_wire_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY segment_code, rn

WITH wire_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CCY_CD1,
        COUNT(*) AS ccy_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
)
SELECT
    CCY_CD1,
    ROUND(100.0 * ccy_count / SUM(ccy_count) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total
FROM wire_2025
ORDER BY pct_of_total DESC;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  MTH_NBR,
  wire_transfer_cnt,
  SUM(wire_transfer_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

WITH wr_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        wt.ORGNL_AMT,
        wt.CCY_CD1,
        dt.CAL_DT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND wt.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
),
fx_rates AS (
    SELECT

SELECT

WITH resolved_complaints AS (
    SELECT
        fc.CMPLT_CTG_K,
        fc.CNTCT_STRTD_AT,
        fc.RSLTN_AT,
        EXTRACT(DAY FROM (fc.RSLTN_AT - fc.CNTCT_STRTD_AT)) AS days_to_resolve

    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fc.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG dct ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = dct.CMPLT_CTG_K
    WHERE dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND fc.IS_RSLVD = true
      AND fc.CNTCT_STRTD_AT IS NOT NULL
      AND fc.RSLTN_AT IS NOT NULL
      AND dct.IS_CURR = true
)
SELECT
    dct.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    AVG(rc.days_to_resolve) AS avg_days_to_resolve
FROM resolved_complaints rc

WITH cust_quarters AS (

    d.CAL_YR_NBR,

  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K

WITH dispute_customers AS (

wire_customers AS (

)

);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20240630
    AND DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  INTERSECT
  SELECT LN_ID
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250630
    AND DYS_PST_DUE > 30
) sub

WITH wire_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        fw.CCY_CD1,
        CAST(fw.AMT AS NUMERIC(20,4)) AS amt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fw
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON fw.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND fw.AMT IS NOT NULL
      AND fw.AMT != ''
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CCY_CD1,
        amt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY amt) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1) AS cnt
    FROM wire_2025
)
SELECT
    CCY_CD1,
    CASE
        WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
            (SELECT amt FROM ranked r2 WHERE r2.CCY_CD1 = ranked.CCY_CD1 AND r2.rn = (cnt + 1) / 2)
        ELSE
            (SELECT AVG(r2.amt) FROM ranked r2 WHERE r2.CCY_CD1 = ranked.CCY_CD1 AND r2.rn IN (cnt / 2, cnt / 2 + 1))
    END AS median_amt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY CCY_CD1, cnt
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH mobile_txn AS (
  SELECT
    dt.CAL_YR_NBR,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN ft
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON ft.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
  WHERE ch.IS_CURR = true
    AND ch.DSPLY_NM = 'Mobile App'
    AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY dt.CAL_YR_NBR
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2025 THEN txn_count END) -
             MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count END)) /
    NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_YR_NBR = 2024 THEN txn_count END), 0),
    1
  ) AS pct_growth
FROM mobile_txn;

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR,
  d.CAL_DT AS month_end_date,
  SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR, d.CAL_DT
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_txn

  AND d_txn.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025

SELECT

WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
    c.BUS_ID,
    SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY SUM(f.ORGNL_AMT) DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f

    SELECT
        f.CCY_CD1,
        COUNT(*) AS ccy_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.MTH_NBR,
    COUNT(*) AS monthly_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
  MTH_NBR,
  monthly_count,
  SUM(monthly_count) OVER (ORDER BY MTH_NBR) AS running_total

WITH wr_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        w.ORGNL_AMT,
        w.ORGNL_CCY_CD1,
        w.BUS_DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND w.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
      AND w.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 IS NOT NULL
),
fx_rates AS (
    SELECT
        f.BUS_DT_K,
        f.BS_CCY_CD1,
        f.QUOT_CCY_CD1,
        f.MID_RT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
    WHERE f.RT_TYP_CD1 = 'RT_B'
      AND f.BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN w.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN w.ORGNL_AMT
            ELSE w.ORGNL_AMT / f.MID_RT
        END
    ) AS total_wire_transfer_eur
FROM wr_2025 w
LEFT JOIN fx_rates f
    ON w.BUS_DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
   AND w.ORGNL_CCY_CD1 = f.QUOT_CCY_CD1;

WITH wire_transfers_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CCY_CD1,
        f.AMT::NUMERIC AS amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
ranked_transfers AS (
    SELECT
        CCY_CD1,
        amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY amount) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1) AS cnt
    FROM wire_transfers_2025
)
SELECT
    CCY_CD1,
    CASE
        WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN
            (SELECT amount FROM ranked_transfers r2 WHERE r2.CCY_CD1 = ranked_transfers.CCY_CD1 AND r2.rn = (cnt + 1) / 2)
        ELSE
            (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM ranked_transfers r2 WHERE r2.CCY_CD1 = ranked_transfers.CCY_CD1 AND r2.rn IN (cnt / 2, cnt / 2 + 1))
    END AS median_amount
FROM ranked_transfers
GROUP BY CCY_CD1, cnt

SELECT
  MTH_NBR,
  wire_transfer_count,
  SUM(wire_transfer_count) OVER (ORDER BY MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

WITH wr_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.ORGNL_AMT,
        f.CCY_CD1,
        f.BUS_DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    WHERE f.BUS_DT_K >= 20250101
      AND f.BUS_DT_K <= 20251231
      AND f.ORGNL_AMT IS NOT NULL
),
fx_rates AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_DT_K,
        CCY_CD1,
        MID_RT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D
    WHERE BS_CCY_CD1 = 'EUR'
      AND QUOT_CCY_CD1 = CCY_CD1
      AND RT_TYP_CD1 = 'RT_A'
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN w.CCY_CD1 = 'EUR' THEN w.ORGNL_AMT
            ELSE w.ORGNL_AMT / f.MID_RT
        END
    ) AS total_wire_transfer_amount_eur
FROM wr_2025 w
JOIN fx_rates f
    ON w.BUS_DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
   AND w.CCY_CD1 = f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT 
    d.MTH_NBR,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS declined_share_pct
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY declined_share_pct DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  D_CAL_DT.CAL_YR_NBR,
  f.STLM_CCY_CD1 AS currency,
  SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D_CAL_DT ON f.BUS_DT_K = D_CAL_DT.DT_K
WHERE D_CAL_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY D_CAL_DT.CAL_YR_NBR, f.STLM_CCY_CD1
ORDER BY D_CAL_DT.CAL_YR_NBR, total_wire_transfer_volume DESC
